hints.title: Group 2 Connectivity Mask
hints.text: Represent the subset of points in group 2 that have been connected so far as an integer bitmask.

hints.title: Advance Point by Point
hints.text: Process group 1 points sequentially from index 0 to size1 minus 1.

hints.title: Connect Remaining Group 2 Nodes
hints.text: When all group 1 points are processed, connect any remaining disconnected group 2 points to their cheapest group 1 neighbor.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: size1 is number of points in group 1 (<= 12)
size2 is number of points in group 2 (<= 12)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all possible bipartite subgraphs requires checking 2^(size1 * size2) combinations, which is far too large.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask dynamic programming memoizes 12 * 4096 states, reducing exponential graph search to milliseconds.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that points in group 2 unvisited by group 1 can greedily take their minimum edge cost at the base case.
